'''Bruan''' is the [[clan chief]] of the [[Nakai]] [[Aiel]]. 

==Appearance==
He is massively built and strong, with gray eyes.

==History==
He has a placid nature. An excellent fighter and tactician, he wholeheartedly believes in the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'', [[Rand al'Thor]].

==Activities==
His clan is the sixth to arrive at [[Rhuidean]] where he waits for all the rest of the clans to gather there.{{ref/book|5|2}}

He leads his Aiel clan when he is sent to the [[Plains of Maredo]] when Rand gathers a massive army in preparation for the attack on [[Illian]].

== Possible future ==
In [[Aviendha]]'s vision of the future in Rhuidean, Bruan survives the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]] and is part of the war committee that decides the Aiel will go to war with the [[Seanchan]].
